[SWS_UCM_00203]
TransferData
InvalidTransferId
⌈
TransferData shall raise the
error
ApplicationError InvalidTransferId
in case an invalid TransferId (An ID
that was not initiated by TransferStart or marked invalid by DeleteTransfer or Revert-
ProcessedSwPackages) is sent by the client.
